claims.quote: Endemic to Peru where it's been collected from several rivers including the Rio Ucayali, Rio Itayi and Rio Pacaya.
The type was found in Peru ("Caño yarina", on the bank of the River Pacaya, tributary of the Puinahua Canal, arm of the lower Rio Ucayali).
